rongmei.title: Mbaan paapc mun lao hei karim gaina

lines: 1. Mbaan paap mun lao hei karim gaina puang the
Khou tei kandimei guai baanthaina puai tat bam,
Ringsuangmei Raguangta pat louna puai tat bammei nun tei
Maikuam ta houpui nung kap puni the.
Ravguangc rui lalou pui gan rimei nun tei
Asei kaobam khou guang makmei nun tei
Ringsuangmei namdai raengmun guai tei
Mbang rikan puni
Hei nung tei kaopui khuan chudat lak khe.
2. Mbaan panti gai khou khuanzaengna pou rui kau
Mbaan pap munlau khou rui duakpat khang kau
Ringsuangmei Raguang lat piu makna puaitat bammei nun tei
Mbaam ta tamni khou kaap puni the.
3. Tuzanghna neilana baanthaina bammei nun
Pou zauzian ta amu louna puai bam meinun
Poubaomei zauzian ngan loupui nung
Kandii taan luai pui nung
Pou khuanta ning lana kap puni the.
4. Poubaomei kei puni thanmei nunta lakhang
Pap khou rui duak patna
Chamdaan bammei nun mu
Ringsuangmei namdai khou tei gutni
Theimei makpui ramkhou
Ringmei pirun runna ruan tat bamni.
